book.name: Gutut
book.title: Gutut Iesu watu enamot mega nagire guturewa

content: Iesu apan Sol imua wat entanen
Pa sewa Ierusalem gapan apan Sol Iesu anu tumasine nagirewa guramopen menan tue ene waiwandin. Me pirisi ayop mugawa ine aen.

Aro warapen ogewa ware amba at Damaskas aepen menan mupe wan. Ok ame wapi gapan Iesu anu tumasine nagirewa, waen ge apan ap mepe wanumopi damiga panamo ai okonak pa Ierusalem ewagai entan onapen menan aen.
Menan Sol entane Damaskas di aiwandin eni amba pa maniwandini gapan, menawaet kiman ganasewa gamup enun, ine maine iragi ganase wan.
Kiman ganat ewa enuni Sol man osi gagap onana pia gearen nop da inap anega tauen anun, “Sol, Sol, ge dimen ta koeragam nimanegingi?”
Sol gare singui wan, “Ayop, ge da?” Amba nop ame anega sia tauen, “Ma ne Iesu ta koeragam nimanegingi.
Endi ao yon pa Damaskas ak, ap mepe apan da dim da tapen menan wadiageta.”
Tanam amone apane wai yonan kiman ganasewa yawan ununke anun go mu no gwade wan. Nop wani anune go nop da wani tavewa ase ya yawan.
Sol piupa ao yone yangut tapen tani, go yamewa borasen. Evene wai nanip waran amon pa Damaskas tauan.
Sol yamewa wam yampoa boraseni wanden ap wamewa gapan kaum ge taba da ya naiwandin.
Ananayas Sol wat inakamen
Iesu wadiamot mega da yaua Ananayas at Damaskas gapan wande en. Bet ine gapan Ayop Iesu yaveni, amba Iesu anega wan, “Ananayas.” Me gare wan, “Ne mam, Ayop negawa.”
Wani Ayop Iesu sia wadien, “Ge ao yon, negin da yaua Tamanawa ak. Apan Diudes paewa gapan Sol, at Tasas apanewa, age yop ta. Sol endi God inap mup waiwan.
Me bet ine manega yaven, apan Ananayas ine tauep, yame boraseni watapep yangut sia tapen menan naniwa iap barae mup wan.”
Ananayas Iesu nop mega anuni gare wadien, “Ayop negawa, apan Sol ame waenapan gega at Ierusalem gapan kaimakaet ta koeragam mumiwandini oisewa apan arugataet wadianegene anun.
Mapa Damaskas tauen pirisi bawarewa aro waneni gapan inagap anu tumat taintoni taunepen menan tauen.”
Iesu gare Ananayas dien, “Sol nao nega arita da tapen menan ne om enun. Ap menan ge di ak. Me Diu ian ugupe nagirewa amba mu ayop mugawa den amba at Isurero nagirewa oitana wadidiamota.
Nenan ugu vegaek bagu sisi baware anupi nek wa ewatain.”

Menan Ananayas aeni boge apan Diudes pa mega taueni me naniwa Sol iap baraeni ap anega wan, “Sol, apan negawa, Ayop Iesu watu enanegen. At mame ongingiana gapan, me apan negina yawaanawa daiton ameme di. Me watu enanegen menan ge yangut sia tapen amba Guewa Posewa Woup Seni potagap no dotouepen menan tauan.”
Wani boge meo epi yarewa mini Sol yamewa gapan tot tat wa geamone me sia yangut tan. Ao yoneni Ananayas Sol Iesu anu tumat dupewa gapan ien.
Sol taba nani gapan aro mega sia tauen. Sol pa Damaskas gapan opata wan Sol aro wareni ewap, me at Damaskas gapan wam agiap Iesu anu tumat taine nagirewa ap mepe tanamo wande en.
Wam ame gapan me opata ere Diu opata waine paewa gwanap, anega wadiamon, “Iesu me God otua di.”

Mu da iragi me wan anunewa tarak anega wane, “Apan mame pa Ierusalem gapan Iesu anu tumasine nagirewa enu girigam mume taiwandini apanewa go? Me mapa taueni iwa mega mu tambumo ae pirisi bawarewa munep gwat noke gapan seat anu tauen go?”
Ap anega wane go Sol aro ta opata di waiwandin. Me opata gapan aigap di ewamuiwandini ame Iesu me God om enuni apanewa Keriso di. Diu pa Damaskas wanumuine nagirewa nop gare wapen tane go umap uon.
Sol muma karaua tau aen
Wam aruga taue ewagai aeni ewap, Diu nagirewa Sol to boniga baraet anun menan nop panan.
Mu Sol menan mum wam pot poraet togurapen menan pa sewa sin gapan tonana Sol menan nauase taiwanumun. Go Sol omine wane oisewa anun.
Mum da Sol kaenat gwanap unugen damik panan amba wadiamot megawa pa sewa Damaskas sin garip kaenat ame damigewa gapan enuanane vise tau aen.
Sol Pa Ierusalem aen
Sol pa Ierusalem aeni Iesu wadiamot mega nagirewa intum tamot anun, go mu iragi tawa tane, iwa mu Sol Iesu anu tumaseni oisewa da mu ya anu tumasene.

Go apan da yaua Banabas, Sol ware Iesu watu enamot megawa ine nau tauen. Taueni amba Banabas Sol gutut mega anega wadiamon, “Sol ap daio Damaskas negina aiwandini gapan Ayop Iesu ire yaveni amba Iesu me inap nop dien. Evi amba Sol pa Damaskas gapan Iesu oisewa epara ta wadidiamon.”
Banabas ap anega wani menan Sol tanam wanden pa Ierusalem gapan ise ase momonagaet yone iwandin amba Iesu oisewa eparae den wadidiam wandin.
Sol nop kaimakaet Diu ame Gurik noa waine nagirewa den tanamo gare gare waiwanumune, go mu togurep boet anun di taiwanumun.
Tot wan tane oisewa Iesu anu tumasine nagirewa anune menan mu Sol waran vit amon pa Sisaria tauan amba Sol watu enane at Tasas aen.

Wam ame gapan Iesu dugup megawa ikukuk wanumunewa at Diudia, Galili amba Sameria iragi nonup gapan wanumen. Ap gapan Guewa Woup Seniwa aroe muneni gapan paua muga kai ware doren amba Iesu viriwa taiwanumun.
Pita pa Lida ge pa Diopa daio aen
Pita at da da daio tan. Wam da God waenapan mega pa Lida gapanawa inamu den daio aen.
Apan da yaua Aeneas tautanen, me dai tanen eragi gagap aup parata iniwandini en mega nani yamunaet nani yamu yampo wande en.
Pita apan ame anega dieni, “Aeneas, Iesu Keriso wat inakam gimagiwan. Ao yon eragi gega pait,” boge Aeneas menawaet ao yon wanden.
Waenapan aru ame pa Lida ge Saron gapan wanumuinewa, inak ame yawan boge imu pose wat entanen Ayop anu tumasene.
Pa da ame yaua Diopa ap mepe Iesu wadiamot waenewa da yaua Tabita (ian Gurik yaua muga gapan ame Dorokas diane) me inat wandet mega kakae iragen wanden. Me waenapan purapuse uoni ame ago tamuiniwa.
Koni ame gapan me vek waren boen, etua bigi ton pa diri gagap tune ame aigapewa gwanap baraene wande en.

Pa Lida ae Diopa taueni ame konintu di, nononga uon. Ap menan pa Diopa Iesu anu tumasine nagire, Pita pa Lida gapan wandeni oise anun, menan apan dere sep watu enamon amon Pita anega diane, “Mek menawaet ao yona nunan mapa di tau.”

Ap menan Pita oit ame anuni yone tanam di aen. Pa ame taueni wat naun pa aigape ame gwanewa dot amon. Pa ame gwanewa unugeni waen kwapura mugenataet tauan nau panan irip turup waiwanumune, Tabita kabani wandeni gapan en wapagin etumu okome taginam muneni ame tambun Pita ewasene.

Pita waen ame wa oimon tauan garip amone, me omanip enu God inap mup wan. Boge waen boe wandeni inap entane anega wan, “Tabita ao yon wanik,” boge waen ame yame emeramen, Pita ao yaveni boge yone nip endaven.
Pita waen nanip ao waren yon wanden. Pita Iesu anu tumasine nagirewa ge waen kwapura ame munan wan tauan, waen boeni ame sia inakaeni ewamon.
Pita ame tani oisewa at Diopa iragi senare tau aen amba waenapan anune boge Ayop Iesu anu tumasene.
Pita wam agiap da pa Diopa gapan man epi getaven darakamini apane da yaua Saimon dere inane.
